column2: Gotigin — Haba ka teknologi i iakynduh bad ka jingshem
Haba ka teknologi i iakynduh bad ka jingshem.
Ki system kam na ka bynta ka business.
OS jaka bam. Ki meja, KOT, ki bill, pynkut ka sngi.
Ka meja courier. Book, ki party, kot sngi.
Kirana. Ka katalog, stock, khata, ka receipt GST.
Ka meja dawai. Batch, expiry, stock, ki bill GST.
Memon na ka bynta «shuh shuh». Ki tiar · Ki app · Shuh shuh.
Ki tiar, ki util, bad ki app kiba lah ban pyndonkam biang. Kam dei u messenger.
Ki khubor SIM, Android shwa. LAN bad Bluetooth ki sah sha free.
Ka layer internet ba lah ban jied na ka bynta ki gateway ba la iasoh.
Ka jingkynthup sha WhatsApp Cloud API.
Ki rukom pyndonkam na ka bynta gotigin.com.
Ka policy pynkut bad pynphai pisa.
Ka email, ka phone, bad ka lynti sha ka jingpule.
Ki kyrteng, ki jingpule, bad ki jaka.
Ka registration ka kompani bad ki contact.
Ka kompani private ba la khang ka jingkitkhlieh. Dhoraji, Gujarat. La pynlong ha ka 24 June 2026.
La khang da ki share · Gujarat
GST ba jia · na ka 04 July 2026
Ka long valid haduh ka 23 June 2036
Memon na ka bynta «iap shem» · la kren go-tee-geen
Ki system business · ki tiar bad ki app · iti khubor
Rung na ka bynta ki jingpule ka jaka kompani Gotigin. Ki jingsynshar kum ha ki jaka jingpule — ka email, u provider, ne ka phone.
Bteng da ka email, u nongai, lane ka phone.
Phah biang ia ka email jingpynshisha
Thoh ia ka address email ba dei.
Pyndonkam ia ka ktien rieh ba don 6 ki dak lane kham bun.
Ka email lane ka ktien rieh ka bakla.
La khang ia ka window jingrung.
Kane ka domain kam don jingbit na ka bynta Firebase Auth.
Kata ka lad ban rung kam pat sdang.
Bun palat ki jingpyrshang. Pyrshang biang hadien.
Pyndonkam ia u nombar phone baroh bad u code ri (kum +91…).
Uta u code SMS u bakla lane u la kut ka por.
Don ei ei kaba la bakla.
Ym pat pynshisha ia ka email — peit ia ka inbox jong phi
La phah ka email pynskhem — peit ia ka inbox jong phi
